name: OCMaker AI
tagline: OCMakerAI is an AI-powered platform for creating original anime characters, avatars, and character sheets in seconds
description: OCMakerAI is an AI-powered platform for creating original anime characters, avatars, and character sheets in seconds. Users can generate consistent characters from text prompts, customize poses, expressions, outfits, and styles, and build complete OC profiles for games, VTubers, comics, roleplay, and social media. Designed for anime fans, artists, creators, and storytellers, OCMakerAI makes high-quality character creation fast, accessible, and fun — without requiring drawing skills.
